{{< include ../_includes/lang-switcher/modules.en.qmd >}}

Imagine this site as a short trip with four stops—and each stop now has **four lessons** (sixteen sittings in all), matching the owner's source-pack branches.

You begin in a garden and a kitchen—plants, processing, brewing, and the compounds in a mug. You travel inward into the body and brain. You climb out again into history, monasteries, warm hands, and ritual. You end in a lab where people play careful games about risk and trust. Each lesson answers a question the previous one left hanging.

Nothing here requires a science degree. Each lesson opens with a hook, walks you through the facts in story order, cites sources with **clickable footnotes**, tucks denser detail into **collapsed foldouts**, and leaves previous/next doors open.

| 3. History, Ritual & Warmth | Is tea only chemistry—or also empire, ritual, and a warm hand? | [Module 3 hub](module-03/index.qmd) |
| 4. Decisions & Choices | Does the cup change how we choose—and how do researchers even measure that? | [Module 4 hub](module-04/index.qmd) |

Why **four** lessons per module, not three? The source packs already use a four-branch skeleton in every module. Splitting one long chapter into those four sittings keeps each page a full sitting—without stuffing three topics into an oversized scroll.

## If you only have ten minutes

**"What do aisle labels mean?"**  
Start with [Tea basics](../tea-basics.qmd), then [Module 1 hub](module-01/index.qmd).

**"What's in my cup?"**  
Start with [Cup reference](../cup-reference.qmd), then lessons [1.3 Brewing](module-01/03-brewing.qmd) and [1.4 Compounds](module-01/04-compounds.qmd).

**"Why awake but not jittery?"**  
Go to [Module 2 hub](module-02/index.qmd), then the [Linkages](../linkages.qmd#1-why-waiting-after-the-first-sip-matters) bridge on L-theanine timing and calm brain waves.

**"Is tea only chemistry?"**  
No. [Module 3 hub](module-03/index.qmd) is the zoom-out: trade, monasteries, warm mugs, brewing breaks.

**"Do drinks change choices?"**  
[Module 4 hub](module-04/index.qmd)—with the packs' caveats that lab doses are not your everyday mug.

When you are ready to begin at the beginning, open [Module 1](module-01/index.qmd). The water is already hot.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Click for more detail: footnotes and foldouts"}
- **Footnotes:** superscript numbers jump to the full citation; the caret jumps back. Hover often pops the note.
- **Foldouts:** boxes titled "More detail…" or "Click for more detail" stay closed until you open them—so the main story stays readable while the expansion stays one click away.
:::
